source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Multiple of a sum is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide whether a multiplication over a sum or difference can be' is answered as multiple of a sum rather than distributive property.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Multiple of a sum is what produces distributive property, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide whether a multiplication over a sum or.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: distributive property is settled by running 'Decide the order for evaluating an unbracketed expression that': When brackets do not specify the order, evaluate each term first, including multiplication — on the item about Decide whether a multiplication over a sum or.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Distributive property is found by dividing the given values instead of multiplying, giving 73 as the reported result — on the item about Decide whether a multiplication over a sum or.

intelligence.enrichment: The multiple of a sum or difference is the same as the sum or difference of the multiples.
